subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + VPC/KMS routing confirmation
messages:
From: A. Lopez <alopez@rivermed.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@rivermed.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + VPC/KMS routing confirmation

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week — Rivermed's security and procurement teams are moving fast. Procurement asked me to gather the following so we can clear the vendor security checklist and finish the SOW: 

- A completed SIG and CAIQ where possible (or a point-by-point export)
- SOC 2 report (or SOC 2 readiness summary) and the date of last assessment
- A concise document confirming: production hosting regions you guarantee for our tenant (we need US-only by default, with EU fallback if requested)
- VPC/private endpoint architecture for the private deployment option (diagram + operator/control-plane separation)
- KMS routing: where customer keys are hosted, and whether cross-region key routing occurs for replication or backup

If you can attach a short "hosting confirmation letter" that procurement can attach to the PO (one page, clear language about region commitment and private endpoint behavior), that would be ideal. Also please call out any remaining SIG gaps (we understand not everything can be completed immediately).

We'd like to close the security checklist by EOD Friday (UTC). Is that timeline feasible?

Thanks,
Alicia Lopez
Sr. Security Program Manager 
Rivermed Health

--
Attachment: procurement_requirements_v2.pdf (referenced)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: A. Lopez <alopez@rivermed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + VPC/KMS routing confirmation

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We can get you a package and a short hosting confirmation letter by Friday. Quick summary of what I attached to this reply: 

1) redwood_privatelink_runbook.pdf — private endpoint runbook (diagram + operator/control-plane responsibilities, authentication flows).
2) sig-gap-summary.xlsx — a concise table marking SIG sections we can fully answer today and a short remediation plan for items where we need additional evidence.
3) kms-routing-diagram.png — shows our default KMS topology and how customer-managed keys (BYOK) are bound to region-local HSMs; includes notes on replication behavior.

High-level answers up front: 
- Residency guarantee: For Dedicated/private deployments we support tenant placement in a single region (US-East or US-West) with no cross-region compute replication unless explicitly enabled. Backup snapshots are optionally replicated to the customer-designated region; by default backups remain in-region. We will provide the one-page commitment letter with explicit wording for procurement.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM in the chosen region. Cross-region key wrapping is disabled by default. Any replication or cross-region key use is a configuration option that must be explicitly accepted in the contract and provisioning doc.
- VPC: Private deployment uses a dedicated VPC per tenant, private endpoints (Privatelink-style) to the control plane, and strict operator separation. The runbook explains operator roles and audit log flow.

I asked Marissa and Irene to review the hosting letter draft and sign off on the procurement wording. If procurement needs specific binding language, loop in your legal and I can pull in our legal contact for a brief call.

Timeline: We can provide the attachments and the draft hosting confirmation letter by Friday 05/21 EOD your timezone. If you need anything earlier, let me know and we'll prioritize.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: redwood_privatelink_runbook.pdf, sig-gap-summary.xlsx, kms-routing-diagram.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: A. Lopez <alopez@rivermed.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + VPC/KMS routing confirmation

Alicia — looping in a short suggested paragraph for procurement: 

"Redwood Inference confirms that for the Customer (Rivermed Health) tenant, production compute and storage will be instantiated and served from the United States region designated at time of provisioning. Redwood will not perform cross-region compute replication for the Customer unless explicitly documented and agreed in writing. Backup replication and disaster recovery replication to an alternate region requires Customer approval and will be described in the SOW appendix. Customer-managed key material (BYOK) will be stored in region-local HSM/KMS and will not be routed across regions by default. Redwood will provide audit logs showing KMS usage and key access events as part of contractual RTO/RPO obligations."

If procurement wants that as an individual signed letter, we can export as PDF and provide a DocuSign flow. Irene, any additional legal/controls language to add?

—Marissa
Head of Product — Redwood Inference

From: A. Lopez <alopez@rivermed.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@rivermed.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ evidence + VPC/KMS routing confirmation

Thanks Sean and Marissa — this is exactly what procurement needs. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you convert Marissa's paragraph into a one-page signed hosting confirmation (PDF) we can attach to the PO? Please include contact info for Redwood's security lead for any follow-up.
2) Procurement wants explicit language about fallback behavior: if Rivermed later requests EU residency for a subset of workloads, please state whether Redwood will support a customer-requested region migration and the expected escalation path and timeline (we don't need the full migration SOW now, just the commitment statement).

If we can get the signed PDF and a DocuSign link by EOD Friday that would keep us on track to issue a PO next week. I can also share a redlined MSA via DocuSign once we have the confirmation letter.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alicia Lopez
Sr. Security Program Manager
Rivermed Health

--
Procurement note: please include a copy of SOC2 or readiness summary in the docusign evidence packet
